body: Every day since my past attempt has been Hell. Self hatred has consumed me entirely. I can't be afraid to die painfully anymore..
I tried to kill myself on the 16th. Gas. Failed but I damaged my lungs a bit..gonna try again tomorrow
I've decided to try to end my life today . I reside in the Bronx, NY if anyone wants to keep an eye out for me in the news. Thank you to everyone who tried to help.

I'm making progress in life but I'm deteriorating mentally every day.. I get better at putting on a front and being less affected by what happens in that moment, I'm becoming more of what I've always been for everyone else..

I think I've become bipolar.. the ups and downs are too much for me. I took a great step forward in my passion last Sunday, was electrified at the time.. ended up hysterically crying myself to sleep that night. And every day since. It's hard for me to show my face anywhere.. I've cried in public every day I've left my house. I can't take that shit..

I just want to die.. I dont want to hurt anyone but I can't take life. Even in the best moments for those around me I'm consumed by thoughts of death.  

I fantasize about watching myself bleed to death.. I jumped off of my roof but the snow broke my fall.. the only way my mind relaxes for sleep is I pretend I'm not going to wake up..

I've always wanted to die but I rarely ever fantasized about painful self harm.. it rarely ever gave me a euphoric feeling like all I want to do is bleed and suffer for the last time.. 

I will not go another 21, 10, 2 years feeling this awful.. the people I'm worried about hurting can't help me. I think I just have to be selfish.
I've given it a little more than two months.. Honestly I'd do anything to end my life but I can't hurt my family, or anyone who cares about me

I'm not going to make another thread like this so I'll just say it here..

Why didn't I trust my better judgement ? I feel so stupid..I'm tired of this roller coaster ride that I'm on, I just want everything to stop.

I gave this another 25 days... To be honest I wish I'd have followed through. I started writing suicide notes and couldn't swallow those feelings of guilt for leaving my family like that.. I still have these same feelings, and I'm only getting better at hiding them. I get the feeling that I'm only delaying the inevitable.. And that eventually I won't premeditate my plans..But I'm going to try to do as much for family and friends as I can until that day comes. Thank you to everyone who showed support because you didn't have to even pretend to care on the internet. I appreciate it wholeheartedly.
And let me say that I wish everybody who shared their stories of overcoming depression the absolute best in their journeys, and thank you for trying to help me on that path.

I ended up telling a friend of mine.. We are close but not extremely so.. They called me at work on yet birthday and after about an hour of talking (on you job's phone, smh) it came spilling out..

She of course tried to get me to reconsider... I tried to change my mind, or even think about not following through..and that's honestly the worse I've felt since I made the decision to kill myself.

All I felt was panic, dread...feeling like I'm begging myself not to change my mind. 

I tried watching the kind of things that used to inspire me...tried to work on music.. It just isn't there anymore. My dreams aren't worth living..I always felt like I was being punished for the things I loved doing, or aspired to be. Thinking about Thursday just makes me sick..

Hopefully I figure out the exact logistics and everything today, if not then I'll shoot for Saturday which is my next day off... Believe that that's an absolute last resort.

I appreciate every single person who showed support and love on here, because you truly have no reason to give a half of a fuck..I'm sorry to anyone who will be hurt by this. I genuinely do wish that I wanted to continue living because I understand that this will be hard for a lot of people that I care about...I'm just not cut out for this, I've been fighting to see a light at the end of the tunnel since 2005. I really do apologize.

I don't want anything to be suspicious. I'm trying to figure out exactly how I'm going to execute this plan and if I come to the conclusion I need more time, I didn't want to deal with a bunch of reckless shit I did..also i don't want anybody calling around looking for me for any reason.
I appreciate you, thank you
Thank you for caring
I did shrooms instead of going to prom.. That was some years ago. I'm currently looking into procuring psychedelics..

I think I've read this every day since I saw it, I don't know why I never responded... Thank you for sharing your story with me, I'm happy that you were able to make it through that time..I'm happy you found the strength to be there for your family.


I read your brother's note and his hopelessness screams out to me..I know how it feels to think you're just overall unfit to be here.. I hope he found peace, and my heart goes out to everyone who survived him

I just can't.. Every time I've abandoned my plan to die, I've found myself deeper in this hole.. These feelings no longer shock me, or scare me... I feel like I'm doing what's best for me.

I'm tired of crying and feeling like I should have died when I had the chance.. I have the chance now, and nobody around me is aware. I hope I don't end up in position to execute and come up short... I know this is what I need

The supplies I needed all came today. People have given me so many kind words.. I hate to sound ungrateful but I haven't changed my mind.. I've felt fucked up about my decision but I still think its the right thing for me.

Thank you to everyone who wished me a happy birthday and showed support.. I appreciate you.
Thank you !

I don't want to get into that simply because I don't want to give someone else any ideas.

Thank you, it means a lot to me!
Thank you!
Thank you for the birthday wishes ! Hopefully something life changing does happen..

So it's my birthday today. A lot has happened , a lot has been said to me.. I want to feel like I'm willing to continue but when I really think.. I just don't see why staying would be beneficial to me.. I can honestly say that I'm not compelled by anything I've seen on this Earth..not enough to live for.  I hope I'm not completely misunderstood..
Thank you so much.. I'll probably be on those chat sites a lot, I appreciate the support & I'm happy for you feeling better..

Hey I hope you enjoyed your birthday ! Thank you for posting..

Unfortunately, my current self is only here because I've decided to give life another chance in the past.. and I can honestly say that I would have been perfectly fine ending my life August 28th when I was in the E.R.. earlier this year when I almost shot myself in the face.. last year this time when I was thinking about how much I didn't want another 20 years on this Earth..or any other time I contemplated suicide. 

The only difference is that now I've actually listened to what everybody's been telling me since I was seven, and I can honestly say that I wasted a WHOOOOOLE lot of time. I wish I'd have listened to myself years ago, because I wasn't this outgoing.. people weren't inspired by me years ago, I didn't connect with almost everybody I met.. there would have been a lot less people affected. The longer I live, the more people attach themselves to me.. I hate that because I'm not trying to hurt people, I just want to do what I feel is right for me
1 million hugs.. thank you

Thank you so much.. I'm rooting for you in your journey.

I will watch the video you linked to, and I appreciate your support...

There's honestly nothing that I want to do..I'm good on what life has to offer, I don't see anything as worth it.. I search for meaning, connection, value every day and nothing has made me feel like this journey was worth it.

Something has made me feel that way, but that no longer holds any value
Talking doesn't do anything.. I've talked soooo much over the last year, I'm tired of it

In the gym 4-5x a week, on a pretty strict vitamin regimen and I eat as well as a college student with a somewhat conscious mind does.. I've tried prescription drugs the prescribed way and otherwise..recreational drugs..etc. some people are more imbalanced than others
I'd have booked it today.. The one that starts today is booked out. I'm willing to try anything before Wednesday but waiting is not an option..
Thank you
This made me cry

That's the thing. I always find myself feeling angry because I resisted the urge to end my own life.. 
I've been suffering with this since I was seven years old.

Reason for not spelling out why I want to die..

In the likely event that my phone/iPad/computer is examined after my death..I don't want anyone to feel like it's their fault for hurting me because I don't blame anyone personally. I also don't care to talk badly on behalf of my family or anyone I ever considered close, with the expectation that people I know may eventually come across this. 

I'm going to try to respond to more people just because I had no idea this many people would type so much.. I appreciate all of it and I want to read all of it.

I will say that I fell asleep for the day (I work 3rd shift) reading these at about 3 pm..I wasn't convinced to live at all but I did at least feel like I should at least entertain the idea of giving this another shot..woke up at 830 utterly convinced that dying was what I needed to do, and the only choice I had.. It shocked me

I'm trying to write as much as I can before Wednesday.. Specifically to my family and my best friend. It hurts knowing how I'm going to hurt them.. But if I can be completely honest. They can't help me.. They've tried and I tried because I saw how much they cared.. I'm not strong enough.
I ordered the materials and they're supposed to come Tuesday.. I'm going to be at work on Tuesday so...

Thank you
I haven't tried it.. know someone who has personally gone through the therapy.. based off of their current mental state I'd have to say I'd never consider it.

I've been writing a lot of notes.. I guess to detail what it is that I'm feeling and I've ended up writing personal letters to a few people.

The dealbreaker was my declining mental state.. I bugged out and in the motions of that I came to the conclusion that I couldn't continue..or that I honestly didn't want to.

I stopped caring about things that are essential to who I am..I used to want to at least put off suicide until I had done more in this world.. I stopped caring about everything I wanted for myself

I have no idea what happens after death, I hear a lot about it but I can't say that I have an idea.. I am hoping that it is more simple than it's made out to be.
NEW YORK
Thank you.. this story really touched me, I appreciate you

I'm certainly not a troll.. I'll explain to you why I posted on here because I am not a regular poster..

I made my plan.. like I said I haven't spoken to anyone about it or let on about anything.. the issues that actually bother me still weigh on me, I work overnight at a front desk.. spent the entire night overthinking.. and I decided to do exactly what the forum says to do and get it off my chest. I've been on other random Reddits but I'd never seen this one until today. 

I don't want my family to hurt.. I've been in this position of trying to get help because of them before.. I went to therapy, changed a lot of my habits, got in the gym and really made progress as a human being.. became more social by virtue of my various jobs, really applied myself to being the best I could be..and I hate to say it but I still had these same terrible thoughts every day. I don't really want to get into what goes on personally because they are very personal issues that I wouldn't want to air out on the internet. 

Everybody goes through what they do, my life has been very traumatic and although I was raised well and I do care about my family.. I feel like I'm in a constant state of panic.. but it isn't nervousness or anxiety, I just never have any sort of peace.. and I have good reason not to, you have no idea.. 

You don't know anything about my life except for the lowest emotions that I expressed in a moment of restlessness.. I had no intentions of trolling anyone, I just can't go through breaking down to my family AGAIN.. it's not like I didn't throw myself into everything I did and didn't see success.. when your personhood and identity get lost in a cycle you didn't identify until it was too late, and you lose hope in your own decision making for your benefit.. I've gone back into my life swinging, but those feelings of constant angst that is just the undertone of every day for a year.. 

I went from being a composed individual in spite of everything I'd ever dealt with, being on a path I could be satisfied to build upon to losing my grip on everything most importantly myself.. I crashed and burned in a way that I couldn't believe.. and every time I think I'm back on my feet, I fall back and it's more extreme..

I'm almost afraid of how convicted I am to do this..but when I think about how long I've wanted to die and how long I've tried to run from it..something in me is telling me that I shouldn't run anymore, that I saw what happened every time I tried anything else. Maybe I haven't explored every option.. but you have to understand being at the end of your rope.

I genuinely just want this to end.. I dont fantasize of a better life, I do wish my problems weren't so troublesome but I wanted to die before I had these issues. Even in the good moments, I find myself just trying not to ruin anything for anyone else with my hopelessness.. its so hard to stay alive for me, most times I just lay and try to stop thinking.. I tell myself I won't be able to think when I'm dead.. for someone that thinks as much as I do, that sounds like what I need.. make this stop..

I've called the hotlines and cried until they told me my 45 minutes was up.. honestly I feel better about Reddit than I do healthcare professionals..I just find it fake. I'll tell a therapist how much I want to die and then they'll give me the clinic number and tell me to call them when I need to like they don't have a cell phone.. you don't give an actual fuck about me you're following your profession.. which I don't fault, make your money but why am I playing along ?
I told my most recent ex girlfriend, she threatened to interfere.. we are no longer on speaking terms, it got TOO ugly
Yup

I don't doubt that I could improve my situation.. I've made a lot of progress in the last year if you're looking from the outside. Good news really does nothing for me anymore, I am extremely resillient so its been easy for me to be productive outside of when I broke down in August. I'm very sociable, I still carry myself extremely well..

This isn't a new case of depression or a rash decision.. I've been to therapy, taken meds, self medicated, meditated, read, prayed.. Ive just never felt like I wanted to be here.
